subject: Pricing targets and host comparison — next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Matt Hudson <matt.hudson@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:12:05-07:00
Subject: Recap: pricing targets & host comparisons (call notes)

Matt — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30m call + a couple of follow-up asks so we can put a clear commercial proposal on the table.

Highlights from our conversation:
- Current usage profile: you mentioned ~18M tokens/month today with seasonal peaks up to ~30M.
- Target unit economics: you indicated a preferred range of $7–$10 per 1M tokens for initial production, with flexibility on a stepped commitment.
- Current vendor baseline: you noted internal benchmarking with other hosts (roughly mid-teens $/1M for managed hosts today).

What Redwood can do / immediate asks:
1) Benchmark snapshot attached: Redwood_Unit_Pricing_1M_comparison.xlsx — this compares example $/1M across typical host mixes (OpenAI, Anthropic, larger cloud hosts, and optimized open-model hosting with quantization). Please confirm if anything here looks off.
2) Commitment ask: can you confirm a target committed volume for the pilot (we used 12M/mo as a placeholder) and whether you can do a 3–6 month reserved commit to access discounted committed tiers?
3) SLA/Privacy: Monica will follow up on a couple of SOC/PII items you flagged — we included a short list of evidence we'll provide for procurement.

Preliminary pricing concept (discussion-level):
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): ~$13–15 per 1M tokens (managed host parity)
- Small commitment (12M/mo for 3 months): ~$9 per 1M tokens
- Larger commitment (50M+/mo): ~$6–7 per 1M tokens

These are illustrative — Monica will run a quick commitment/discount model and Sergio can translate to a win/loss comparison vs the specific OpenAI/Anthropic bundles you referenced.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm the committed pilot volume and the primary success metrics (latency targets, cost targets, integration milestones)?
- If yes, we’ll draft a short mutual action plan and a pilot SOW + pricing ladder.

Thanks — Sean
--
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attach: Redwood_Unit_Pricing_1M_comparison.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB)
From: Matt Hudson <matt.hudson@aureliahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: engops@aureliahealth.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:04:30-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing targets & host comparisons (call notes)

Sean — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Volumes: current sustained run-rate is ~18M tokens/mo (mostly inference for our triage/chat workflows). Peak testing spikes to ~30M for periodic batch jobs. We expect 20–25% MoM growth for the next 6 months if the pilot converts.
- Budget: our procurement band for this project is currently $8–10 per 1M tokens for the long-term target. For the initial pilot we can stretch to $12 per 1M if performance and reliability meet our SLA (95p latency SLO + 99.9% availability during business hours).
- Vendor baseline: our finance team currently sees effective cost of roughly $14–16 per 1M after fees with the managed host we use today (including model and bandwidth). Anthropic/other managed solutions were in that mid-teens range; we looked at some open-model hosts offering $6–9/1M but they required more ops lift (which we budgeted separately).

Attachments: sending over a one-page product expectations doc so you see our acceptance criteria (Aurelia_MVP_expectations.pdf).

Happy to proceed with the committed pilot concept. For us, a 3-month committed pilot at 12M/mo with a clear roll-to-prod milestone would be ideal; we’d want a short mutual action plan and a one-click DocuSign for the pilot SOW.

Matt
Director, Product (AI)
Aurelia Health
Attach: Aurelia_MVP_expectations.pdf (PDF, 22KB)

Subject: Internal: preliminary pricing ladder and pilot exec summary

Looping in the numbers I ran after the call with Matt. This is internal only — use in the commercial proposal but don’t publish the full calc table to the customer yet.

Assumptions pulled from call:
- Anchor pilot: 12M tokens/mo for 3 months (Aurelia can extend to 18M/mo month-to-month after pilot if SLOs met).
- Expected growth: +20% M/M for 6 months post-pilot.
- Ops cost delta for open-host solutions: we estimate an additional $1.5–2.5/1M in internal engineering/operator costs for self-hosted/partner-hosted solutions at their current team size.

Proposed commercial options (discussion-ready):
A) Pilot (3 mo, committed)
  - Price: $9.25 per 1M tokens
  - Commitment: 12M/mo minimum (36M total)
  - Inclusions: standard logging, prefix cache, basic quality monitoring
B) Production reserved (6 mo, stepped commit)
  - Tier 1 (12–25M/mo): $8.00 per 1M tokens
  - Tier 2 (25–50M/mo): $6.50 per 1M tokens
  - Tier 3 (50M+/mo): $5.50 per 1M tokens
C) Pay-as-you-go
  - Price: $13.50 per 1M tokens (no commit)

Notes: these reflect Redwood’s ability to reduce unit cost via dedicated capacity + quantization-friendly model variants for longer commitments. We should flag potential model-change implications (slight inference quality deltas) and offer a short AB eval run on a small prompt set so Aurelia can validate.

Suggested next internal steps:
- Sergio: produce a short competitive grid vs OpenAI/Anthropic highlighting where committed pricing wins vs paygo parity.
- Sean: draft the mutual action plan + pilot SOW with the $9.25 pilot number and the 3-month commitment.
- I’ll prepare SOC2 artifact list and the AB eval plan.

-Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Matt — thanks for the clear constraints. We’re aligned on a pilot-first approach. Below is a short mutual action plan and next steps. If that looks good I’ll send the pilot SOW + one-click DocuSign link this afternoon.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Pilot length: 3 months (committed)
- Pilot volume: 12M tokens/month minimum (36M total)
- Pilot price: $9.25 per 1M tokens (covers inference + standard logging + 90d support wrap)
- SLA targets: 95p latency SLO; 99.9% availability business hours.
- Acceptance: AB eval on 500 prompts (Aurelia to provide set) with pass/fail criteria (latency + quality delta threshold).
- Procurement steps: we’ll provide SOW + short MSA addendum for pilot; Aurelia to sign DocuSign to activate.

Competitive callouts (for your procurement sheet):
- OpenAI / Anthropic managed tiers are typically higher on paygo; Anthropic examples from your RFP were mid-teens on paygo for the LLMs you referenced.
- Open-model hosts can reach low single digits $/1M but require additional ops investment; we budget that as an internal cost for many customers.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Redwood_Aurelia.docx (docx, 12KB)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Confirm you’re ok with 12M/mo pilot and the $9.25/1M pilot price.
2) Aurelia provides the 500-prompt eval set + PO contact for procurement.
3) I’ll create the SOW + DocuSign link and loop in our SOC contact for the evidence pack.

If you confirm, we can get the pilot started within two business days of the signed SOW.

Thanks again — looking forward to it.
